recipients.name: Eran Lagstein
recipients.subject: Considering Clio or Filevine?
recipients.body:
Hi Eran,

You've built a practice spanning California and Nevada, so keeping case information usable across matters and jurisdictions matters as much as choosing new software.

I'm Pranav, founder of Possible Minds, previously at McKinsey and Expedia. We built Precise Imaging's email-handling system, which processes over 600 emails daily, routes requests and sends automated status responses.

If a change of case-management system is on the table, we can help migrate your records, documents and workflows to Clio or Filevine, with careful mapping and validation so they're better connected for AI and automation.

Here's how we approach migration:
https://getpossibleminds.com/t/EogRC1ZS2Q

Would a brief outline of what a move could involve be useful? I'd appreciate your thoughts.

Best,
Pranav
Founder, Possible Minds
